inputs.prompt:
subject_definitions:
- <Subject 1>: the sole protagonist, a young East Asian female swordswoman with a high ponytail tied by a red cord and loose face-framing black hair strands, calm resolute expression.
- <Picture 1>: front view of Subject 1, wearing her crimson red hanfu robe with black embroidered lapel and trim, a white cross-collar inner garment, wide flowing sleeves with dark leather cuffs, a black wrapped leather belt with hanging red sashes, a layered black-and-red long skirt, and black forearm bracers, holding a straight Chinese jian sword.
- <Picture 2>: side profile view of the same Subject 1 in the identical costume and hairstyle.
- <Picture 3>: back view of the same Subject 1 in the identical costume, showing the red robe back, the black wrapped belt, the high ponytail and the jian held in her right hand.
- <Picture 4>: top-down view of the same Subject 1 in the identical costume.

summary:
Subject 1 walks slowly from a distance along a narrow mossy stone path toward a clearing deep in a misty bamboo forest at dawn, seen mostly from behind and three-quarter angles, while a rustic thatched pavilion stands quietly beside the grove.

retention_analysis:
- Facial identity of Subject 1: fully_preserved from <Picture 1>.
- Hairstyle, high ponytail and red cord: fully_preserved from <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>.
- Full costume — crimson red hanfu robe with black trim, white cross-collar inner garment, black wrapped leather belt with red sashes, wide flowing sleeves with dark cuffs, black bracers, layered black-and-red skirt: fully_preserved from <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, <Picture 4>. The robe must stay crimson red with black trim in every frame; never substitute blue, white, green or any other color, and never restyle the costume.
- Prop, the straight Chinese jian sword: fully_preserved, carried at her side or in her hand.
- The black studio background of the reference pictures: dropped and replaced by the bamboo forest environment.

detailed_description:
- Shot 1 (0.0s-5.2s), one continuous slow tracking shot, no cuts: the camera glides forward behind Subject 1 at shoulder height as she walks deeper into the bamboo grove, matching the back view of <Picture 3> with the same crimson red robe, black belt, ponytail and jian; thin white morning mist drifts between tall green bamboo stalks and soft golden dawn light filters through the canopy, casting dappled light and long shadows on the mossy stone path; her wide sleeves and skirt hem sway gently with each step and the breeze stirs loose hair strands; as she nears the clearing she turns slightly into a three-quarter angle so her face matches <Picture 1> and her front costume details match <Picture 2>; shallow depth of field, cinematic film grain, tranquil atmospheric wuxia mood, natural lighting.

overall_soundscape:
Gentle wind rustling through bamboo leaves, soft footsteps on moss and stone, distant forest birds, peaceful quiet atmosphere.

non_diegetic_music:
Subtle traditional Chinese ambient instrumentation, slow meditative guqin and soft flute pads, low volume, tranquil mood.
